description:
Bad Bad Hats perform at The Current Presents: Minnesota Music Month
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube

The Current hosted Minnesota Music Month back in April, 2025 at Amsterdam Bar & Hall featuring Gully Boys, Bad Bad Hats, Kiss the Tiger, and Lighter Co. 

Watch Bad Bad Hats' full performance above. 

Songs Performed
00:00:00 Gloria Love
00:02:46 Let Me In
00:06:11 Nothing Gets Me High
00:09:41 Walkman
00:12:39 My Heart Your Heart
00:15:28 Talk With Your Hands
00:18:46 Meter Run
00:21:36 Lay Low
00:24:55 Psychic Reader
00:28:38 TPA

Musicians
Kerry Alexander: guitar, vocals
Chris Hoge: guitar, backing vocals
Colby Hansen: bass
Joey Carl Hays: drums
